exposure: spontaneous HIV viral control (<100 copies/mL 2 occasions before or after pregnancy off ART)
cohort: 29 pregnant women with spontaneous HIV viral control in the UK
finding: UK practice in managing pregnant women with spontaneous HIV viral control has shifted from predominantly using ZDVm to a more varied approach including triple ART, but this change has not significantly impacted cesarean section rates.
mod_finding: Post-2012 mode of delivery was varied (5 vaginal, 6 planned cesarean section and 3 emergency cesarean section).
